operations.title: Generic C4 triple incidences are mixed Tate
operations.body: Entry 1162 (event 914) closes the generic forced triple-point layer. The 196 residue pivots contain 296 labelled base triple points; every point has exactly three distinct lines, no hidden four-line incidence. Away from B4=0 each lifts to two deck-conjugate ordinary triple points, with local Orlik-Solomon ranks (1,3,2), hence mixed Tate. Together with 1161, generic C4 non-SNC incidence adds only Tate/Kummer data around elliptic component curves. Remaining falsifier: branch enhancement B4(p)=0.
